There are many tools that we can use to convert markdown to html, pdf and other formats. 

[Pandoc][] is one of the popular tools. In this chapter, we'll learn how to use pandoc to convert markdown into html and pdf. 

[Pandoc]: https://pandoc.org/

## Pandoc

## HTML

To convert a markdown file into html, use:

```session
$ pandoc -s file.md --to html -o file.html
```

The option `-s` makes Pandoc generate a standalone html file.

It is also possible to generate multiple markdown files into a single html file.

```session
$ pandoc -s header.md home.md --to html -o home.html
```

### pdf

To convert markdown file to pdf, use:

```session
$ pandoc file.md --to pdf -o file.pdf
```
